item.title: Trump promised a swing district blitz. He's going to a lot of very red states
item.description: President Trump's midterm travel blitz ahead of Election Day includes several red states he won easily 2 years ago, showing the electoral landscape is more challenging for Republicans.

item.title: No Kings turns its focus to voting this weekend. Here's what we know
item.description: The coalition behind nationwide anti-Trump protests is shifting its strategies this weekend to focus on voter turnout. Organizers say Saturday's events are a nonpartisan effort to get people to the polls.

item.title: Coastal homes burn as hot winds fuel California fires
item.description: High winds are fueling a fast-moving fire that has burned homes in Southern California. Flames engulfed expensive coastal properties and prompted thousands to evacuate.

item.title: Mayor of Bend shares how her community is doing after elementary school shooting
item.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Mayor of Bend Melanie Kebler about how the community is grieving the three children and teacher who were killed in a shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School on Thursday.

item.title: Red ink: Federal deficit hits nearly $2 trillion
item.description: The federal deficit for the fiscal year that just ended was nearly $2 trillion. That's the biggest budget gap since 2021, when the country was still recovering from the pandemic.

item.description: The community in Bend, Ore., is reeling after a shooter killed three children and a teacher at an elementary school Thursday.

item.title: 3 children, teacher killed in shooting at Oregon elementary school
item.description: Three children and a teacher were killed in a shooting at a Bend, Oregon, elementary school Thursday. Officials say a bystander confronted and fatally shot the 16-year-old suspected shooter.
